name: Phillips 66
research_rationale: Commentary reinforces Q3 strength and midstream support but warns on margin fade and recent weakness; unchanged SEC cash metrics partly confirm the buy case without resolving the FCF/EPS screen gap.

weekly_updates.summary:
Nov batch adds commentary on strong Q3 utilisation, midstream cushion and LA28 fuel branding, alongside a reported ~17% one-month share pullback.  
Sell-side pieces question refining-margin durability into 2027; no new SEC filings in sources.  
Filing-aligned OCF/FCF and prior leverage, litigation and regulatory risks are unchanged.
